name: Freetown Peninsula
hook: Golden beaches, twenty minutes from the airport
description: The coastline south of Freetown — Lumley, Tokeh, Bureh, and River No. 2 — palm-backed sand, fresh grilled fish, and some of West Africa's best surf, without the crowds of better-known coasts.

quickFacts.flightNote: Direct international flights into Freetown (FNA), then a short ferry or water-taxi across the estuary
quickFacts.climate: Tropical — hot and humid, with a May–October rainy season

topExperiences: Surfing at Bureh Beach with the local surf club
Grilled barracuda on the sand at River No. 2
A hike up to Leicester Peak for a view over Freetown
